import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    s0 = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    Q = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    b = p[6] + p[7]*T
    return s0 + Q*(1-np.exp(-b*eps)) + p[8]*np.log(eps) + p[9]*eps

import numpy as np
try:
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
except Exception as ex:
    least_squares=None; print("noscipy",ex)
def model(p,e,t):
    a=p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*np.exp(p[3]/t)
    n1=p[4]; n2=p[5]
    return a+(p[6]+p[7]*t)*e**n1+(p[8]+p[9]*t)*e**n2
def res(p): return model(p,eps,T)-sigma
